html:
A canning machine produces underweight cans with constant probability pp. Random samples of nn cans are taken and the number XX of underweight cans recorded. The mean and standard deviation of XX are 2.16 and 1.44 respectively.

  1. XX is a discrete random variable. Explain why it is discrete and random. (2 marks)

  2. Name its distribution and determine nn and pp. (3 marks)

  3. Another machine produces an underweight can with probability 0.015. For a random sample of 30 cans, determine the probability that (i) exactly one is underweight (2 marks); (ii) more than one is underweight (1 mark).

  3. Determine the mean and variance of XX. (4 marks)
